% Where the artifact lives. Single source of truth for all three builds.
%
% This is deliberately NOT in macros.tex: that file is generated by
% tools/paper_numbers.py from experimental records and is overwritten on every
% build, so a hand-edited locator would be silently destroyed.
%
% The build scripts grep the RENDERED pdf for "PLACEHOLDER" and refuse to finish
% while a locator is unfilled, because a dead locator in an availability
% statement is worse than an absent one: it looks checkable and is not.
%
% \fsArtifactLoc is named for what it is -- a locator -- rather than "Doi",
% because a repository URL is what it currently holds. If the artifact is later
% given a DOI (Zenodo can archive a GitHub release automatically), swap the value
% and nothing else changes.
\newcommand{\fsArtifactLoc}{\url{https://github.com/extremefattypunch/forcesketch}}

% Double-blind-safe mirror for the ICLR build. Must not carry the author's name,
% GitHub handle or institution -- which rules out the locator above, since the
% handle is in the URL.
%
% Left EMPTY on purpose rather than placeholdered. anonymous.4open.science can
% mirror the repository with identity stripped, but creating the mirror requires
% granting that service OAuth access to the GitHub account, which is the author's
% decision to make and not a build step. Until it exists, the ICLR build states
% the position plainly instead of citing a link, which is honest and is accepted
% practice at the venue.
%
% When the mirror is created, put its URL here and main_iclr.tex will cite it.
\newcommand{\fsArtifactAnon}{}

% Upstream inputs, which are NOT this work's artifact and must not be conflated
% with it: the multi-head committee checkpoints and the 3BPA/water frames this
% work evaluates. Already public and pinned by hash in the release manifest.
\newcommand{\fsUpstreamZenodo}{10.5281/zenodo.17829635}
